F6.note: Text says Delta<1 'is precisely the perturbativity condition' (3.87). Eq (3.139) gives Delta = 1.63 alpha (Treh/mP)^2 x 10^-55, and Eq (3.88) gives alpha (Treh/mP)^2 Tpsi < 1.22 x 10^55 with Tpsi->1. Together these allow Delta up to ~1.99, not 1 (factor ~2). Same gap shows in (3.89) alpha<6.09e61 versus Delta<1 giving alpha<3.6e61 at T_GUT via (3.140). Also (3.140) 'alpha x 10^-62' drops the 2.76. Moderate confidence.
